answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. A whisper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nectar of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the wharf is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
